title: your first sprite
shortDescription: One textured sprite from a texture atlas, drawn by a Display with a scene and a camera of its own — the place to start
description:
One sprite, drawn with the frame `splotch0` of a texture atlas. The page builds a `Display` on its canvas, a three.js `Scene` and `PerspectiveCamera`, and loads the atlas through a `TextureStore`.

The sprite lives in a `TexturedSprites` mesh, which draws every sprite as one instance: a base vertex object description gives the four vertices of the quad, an instanced one the size, position and texture coordinates of each sprite. [Vertex objects](https://github.com/spearwolf/twopoint5d/blob/main/packages/twopoint5d/src/vertex-objects/README.md) explains what such a description declares.
